title: The last light
subtitle: A small story about finding the way home
author: Your name

characters.name: Mara
characters.description: The lighthouse keeper. Collects things the sea returns.

characters.name: Ellis
characters.description: A traveler with a letter he has never opened.

blocks.text: By the time the stranger reached the lighthouse, the tide had erased his footprints. Above him, a single window held the last **amber light** of evening.
Sets two cups on the windowsill, as though she had been expecting someone.
I wasn't sure there was a short one.
Tell her about the letter. *Before you lose your nerve.*
Some lights are kept for ships. Others are kept for the people who never learned to leave.
Mara turned the envelope over. The paper was soft at the edges, its creases worn nearly through. Outside, the lamp began its patient circle.
What is inside the letter? Leave space for the reader. This private note will not appear in the HTML export.
